svg.text: Search Ranking & Typo Tolerance — Frontend LLD
Typo Tolerance — Edit Distance & Phonetics
Levenshtein distance: min insertions/deletions/substitutions to transform query → token
Damerau-Levenshtein: adds transpositions (ab→ba = 1 edit) — better for typos
Threshold: allow edit distance 1 for len ≥ 5, edit distance 2 for len ≥ 9
BK-tree: metric tree over vocabulary — O(log n) lookup of words within distance k
Trigram index: split "hello" → "hel","ell","llo" → find terms sharing ≥ N trigrams
Soundex / Metaphone: phonetic encoding — "Smith" ≈ "Smyth" → same bucket
Did-you-mean: suggest top-1 correction below threshold + query frequency signal
Prefix match always beats fuzzy — prioritize exact > prefix > fuzzy in ranking
Ranking Pipeline — Multi-Signal Scoring
Stage 1 — Retrieval: BM25 (TF-IDF with field length normalization) → candidate set
BM25 score = IDF × (TF × (k1+1)) / (TF + k1 × (1 - b + b×dl/avgdl))
Stage 2 — Boost signals: field boost (title > description), recency, popularity
Click-through rate (CTR): position-normalized CTR boosts items users actually click
Personalization: user history / preferences → per-user score multiplier
Stage 3 — Re-rank: lightweight ML model (LambdaRank / XGBoost) on top-K results
Diversity: MMR (Maximal Marginal Relevance) — penalize repeated categories
Tie-breaking: deterministic secondary sort (createdAt DESC) → stable pagination
Query Understanding & Expansion
Tokenization: lowercase, strip punctuation, split on whitespace + camelCase
Stop words: remove "the","a","of" — but keep in phrase queries ("band of brothers")
Stemming: "running" → "run" (Porter/Snowball) — increases recall, may hurt precision
Lemmatization: "better" → "good" — context-aware, heavier than stemming
Synonym expansion: "sofa" → OR("sofa","couch","settee") — query-time or index-time
Query classification: detect intent (navigational / informational / transactional)
Spell correction: language model P(correction|query) + edit distance — Noisy Channel
Query rewriting: "cheap flights NYC" → structured {price:asc, destination:"NYC"}
Frontend Search UX & Analytics
Debounce: 200–300ms before firing search request — cancel on new keystroke
Instant results: client-side filter on cached recent queries — feels instant
Result highlighting: wrap matched tokens in <mark>, handle multi-word phrase match
Facet counts: estimated counts (not exact) for performance — warn user of approximation
Empty results: show did-you-mean, related categories, popular searches — not blank page
Analytics: log query, result count, click position, dwell time — feed back to ranking
Zero-result rate: alert if >5% queries return 0 results — signals index or query gap
URL sync: encode q, filters, sort, page in URL — shareable, bookmarkable, SEO-friendly
Typo: DL distance ≤ 1 (len≥5), ≤ 2 (len≥9)
BM25 → boost signals → ML re-rank → diversity
Synonym expansion at query-time or index-time
Debounce 200ms, instant from cache, URL sync
Analytics: CTR + dwell time → ranking feedback loop
